source_note: 原文逐字取自 Hypixel SkyBlock 社区 Wiki 普通页面 DOM 的 Dialogue 表格；Wiki 明示的游戏内拼写或语法错误按原文保留。页面 DOM 不足以证明服务器颜色码，因此不臆测 raw/segments，待实机触发后再补颜色。

messages.text: Have you noticed that it's not possible to enter The Catacombs alone?
messages.zh: 你有没有注意到，玩家无法独自进入地牢?

messages.text: Mort's just really stubborn when it comes to The Catacombs. He's seen so many adventurers get lost down there that he now refuses to let anyone in without a buddy.
messages.zh: Mort 在地牢这件事上非常固执。他见过太多冒险者迷失其中，所以现在没有同伴就不让任何人进去。

messages.text: Not the mention that The Catacombs is extremenly dangerous to explore alone.
messages.gloss: Wiki 注明游戏内原文如此；Not the mention 与 extremenly 的拼写按原文保留。
messages.zh: 更别说独自探索地牢极其危险。

messages.text: Although he won't let the average adventurer pass, he might reconsider it if you're strong enough.
messages.zh: 虽然他不会让普通冒险者通过，但如果你足够强，他或许会重新考虑。

messages.text: Well, for The Catacombs, I reckon that if you have defeated The Professor, he'd probably let you in.
messages.zh: 至于地牢，我想如果你击败过 The Professor，他大概就会允许你进去。

messages.text: If you can do that, I'll give you my personal recommendation!
messages.zh: 如果你能做到的话，我会为你亲手写一份推荐信!

messages.text: Talk to me again when you have done that.
Unfortunately, it seems you haven't yet defeated The Professor! Come back when you have done that!
messages.zh: 很遗憾，看来你还没有击败 The Professor! 击败他之后再回来吧!

messages.text: So, have you defeated The Professor yet?
messages.zh: 那么，你已经击败 The Professor 了吗?

messages.context: 确认已经击败 The Professor 后
messages.text: Then take this letter to Mort whenever you feel like entering The Catacombs alone. Make sure that you're not in a party.
messages.zh: 那么，当你想独自进入地牢时，就把这封信交给 Mort。首先记得先退出队伍（/party leave）。

messages.context: 确认已经击败 The Professor 后

messages.text: Good luck on your solo adventures. I look forward to hearing about your triumphs within The Catacombs!
messages.gloss: Wiki 抄成了 adventurers,2026-09-03 实测服务器发的是 adventures,以游戏为准。
messages.zh: 祝你的单人冒险一切顺利。我期待听到你在地牢中凯旋的消息!
messages.raw: §fGood luck on your solo adventures. I look forward to hearing about your triumphs within §cThe Catacombs§f!

messages.context: 背包中已有推荐信时申请补领
messages.text: I can see that you already have my recommendation letter on you!
messages.zh: 我看得出来，你身上已经带着我的推荐信了!

messages.context: 推荐信已经交给 Mort 后申请补领
messages.text: You've already handed in my recommendation letter! You don't need another one.
messages.zh: 你已经把我的推荐信交给 Mort 了! 不需要再拿一封。
messages.raw: You've already handed in my §6recommendation letter§r! You don't need another one.

segments.zh: 交给 Mort 了! 不需要再拿一封。
